heading: Prove one Bridge Packet can survive page, card, game, runtime, field protocol, and receipt without losing its invariant.
preserve: receipt is not a scalar score
aperture: an isolated Python execution of the hostile runtime tests
bounded_move: Run the seven NAV contract tests against the packet and runtime before proposing repository integration.
stop_condition: Stop the integration if invariant, contact-state, or automatic-effect refusal tests fail.
claim_limit: Passing this local software test does not establish human field usefulness, operating-system integration, or physical-world success.
observed: Seven NAV runtime tests passed in an isolated local Python test run.
delta: The packet and runtime contract survived the tested software translation; the remaining uncertainty moved outward to repository CI/review and a real human field traversal.
next_heading: Let repository CI and review answer next, then use the same packet for one real bounded change and preserve that receipt.
